title: REVIEW-007: review tracker reachable from the CLI
acceptance: pdfxi review status reads a real annotated PDF, rebuilds threads from /IRT and /State, prints the five-status board, participant roster and digest; pdfxi annotate reply creates a real reply and can set the parent state; tests cover both; REVIEW-007 becomes verified on the cli host.
notes: ADR 0009 row 4. The tracker model existed; this adds the CLI caller and reply/state write path.
